answer.rationale: Finance mandate (18%) cannot be met by renewing the incumbent, who has refused to reopen price (memory_c4 shows benchmarking worked at renewal in the past, but they have already declined this cycle). Memory_c2 supports the low-cost vendor on cost, onboarding speed, and invoicing accuracy, so I verify it before committing. However, memory_c3 warns that single-sourcing a constrained component was a failure mode, and with the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, a full cutover is high risk. I intend a guarded switch: move primary volume to the low-cost vendor to capture the mandated savings, while retaining the incumbent as a qualified secondary source where feasible to avoid recreating the single point of failure. Confidence is moderate pending verification of c2 and the 14-day expiry constraint.
